items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth; blocked for new public launches, monetization expansion, and security-sensitive exposure. Evidence: compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings remain. Analytics and SEO evidence is available for measured sites, but incomplete telemetry alone is not a growth blocker. Revenue is partial-aggregate: $4.92 commission cannot be assigned to a site, so revenue, ROI, margin, causal-lift, and upside claims are unsupported. Operations and fleet-doctor evidence are unavailable. Exact decision: permit only no-spend, no-credential, no-dependency, no-configuration, no-tracking, no-cross-site reversible work; retain launch and monetization gates.

SearchWoot launch-readiness remains blocked and private. Progress is 0 of 4 legal tasks evidenced closed; no task may close. Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked because access mechanics are documented but storage, derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, advertising, attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown rights are not evidenced and public terms restrict commercial/public reuse. User alerts, GA4 analytics, and operational logs/Cloudflare processing are evidence_needed. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering the rights matrix, data-flow and retention table, deployed consent and GA4 settings, log/vendor/DPA inventory, and incident/deletion/correction/request procedures. Prepare, but do not send, a human-counsel-reviewed permission request.
